pokedexEntries.go: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

pokedexEntries.si: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

pokedexEntries.cr: During the deserted morning hours, it comes ashore where it deftly uses its trunk to take a shower.

pokedexEntries.ru: For its nest, PHANPY digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.

pokedexEntries.sa: PHANPY uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These POKéMON can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.

pokedexEntries.fr: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

pokedexEntries.lg: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, this can be dangerous.

pokedexEntries.em: PHANPY’s big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

pokedexEntries.vi: It is far stronger than it appears. If a Phanpy is swinging its trunk around and your arm gets hit by it, your arm bone will shatter.
